validity.summary: MISCLASSIFICATION CONCERN, confirming the task's own flag: this segment is filed under the 'Urengoy-Chelyabinsk Gas Pipeline' parent (gem.wiki associated-infrastructure note: 'Bukhara-Ural Gas Pipeline') as a 'Looping' -- i.e. a parallel capacity-adding pipe on that trunk. Three independent, mutually-consistent facts contradict that framing: (1) uglevodorody.ru (13 Jan 2023, independent) lists 'МГ Долгодеревенское – Красногорск' (1020mm) as its OWN separately-named trunk gas pipeline, distinct in the same list from 'МГ Комсомольское – Челябинск' (1420mm) -- the regional name for the Urengoy-Chelyabinsk corridor's Chelyabinsk-Oblast leg. (2) ru.readkong.com's detailed historical article on the Urengoy-Chelyabinsk build independently confirms that corridor's FIRST STRING was commissioned only in October 1979, at 1420mm diameter, running Urengoy-Surgut-Tobolsk-Tyumen-Chelyabinsk. (3) The sheet's own StartYear1 for this segment is 1977 -- two years BEFORE the trunk it is filed as a 'looping' of even existed. A 1020mm line built in 1977 cannot physically be a parallel capacity-loop of a 1420mm trunk not completed until 1979. Diameter (1020 vs 1420) and era both point the same way: this looks like an independently-built, independently-named 1020mm trunk (plausibly connected to the older Bukhara-Ural-era regional gas system serving Chelyabinsk Oblast, alongside its sibling P2297/'Dolgoderevenskoye-Sysert' which shares the Dolgoderevenskoye endpoint, same 1020mm diameter, same operator) that GEM has mis-grouped under the newer, larger, later Urengoy-Chelyabinsk corridor rather than a genuine loop of it.

Recommend a routing decision by Baird: either re-parent this segment as its own independent GEM pipeline row (breaking the Urengoy-Chelyabinsk association) or flag OtherEnglishNames/associated-infrastructure fields pending a source that can actually resolve the ownership chain.

fills.researcher_notes: This 1020mm figure is also the core physical evidence for the classification concern: a 1420mm trunk (Urengoy-Chelyabinsk / Komsomolskoye-Chelyabinsk, per readkong.com) cannot be 'looped' by a smaller, 1020mm parallel pipe in the normal engineering sense -- a looping line matches or approaches its parent's diameter to add parallel capacity. This diameter mismatch plus the 1977 vs 1979 date mismatch (see Start) both point the same direction.
